notes.title: Patch Fix #2
notes.notes:
We've released today an update to address a bunch of issues besides some improvements. We hope you guys like it!
Below a summary of the changes:
- Fixed the first challenge bug.
- Combat and projectile systems modified to better handle the upgrade to PhyX 3.
- Fixed a bug with the gameplay time on multiple Save Slots.
- Fixed a bug after the first boss if you did not completed the first challenge.
- Fixed some problems with the projectiles of all bosses.
- General scene corrections
- Fixed a bunch of visual issues.

notes.title: Patch Fix #1
notes.notes:
Hey guys.
My name is Rafael, I'm one of the developers at Miris Mind.

Thanks for reporting the Challenge bug to us.
We've just rolled back the game to fix this.

Apparently something went wrong when we were fixing visual bugs. 
We're working out to find out what happened and we'll update the game as soon as we have this properly fixed and the new version is tested.

Thanks again for reporting it!
